convention.scope: Explicitly proposed only for this TEST_ONLY branch; no global geometry/range rule change.
convention.positionMeaning: Branch-local proposal convention: p/pos x and y are the center of the occupied footprint; z is the feet/bottom elevation. box supplies full x/y footprint dimensions and full vertical height in feet. All inherited z=0 occupants rest on the supported floor.
convention.nearestSurfaceFormula: For x/y, gap=max(0,abs(center delta)-(footprintDimensionA+footprintDimensionB)/2). Vertically, each occupied interval is [z,z+height]; dz=max(0,max(zA,zB)-min(zA+heightA,zB+heightB)). 3D nearest occupied-surface distance=sqrt(dx^2+dy^2+dz^2). Boundary contact is inside when distance<=10 feet.
convention.calculation: Avatar [20,-20,0], footprint10x10, height10 occupies z[0,10]; Zombie [35,-20,0], footprint5x5,height5 occupies z[0,5]. x gap=max(0,15-(10/2+5/2))=7.5ft, y gap0, vertical intervals overlap (dz0); nearest surface distance7.5ft, inside10ft.
convention.movementPassage: Occupied AABBs may touch at their boundaries without overlapping occupied volume. B starts boundary-adjacent to the Zombie along x; the northward first segment immediately increases separation, and the eastward second segment stays at y=-10, clear of the Zombie at y=-20.
convention.floorConvention: All listed actors and bodies at z=0 have feet at floor z=0, not centered vertically below the floor. No occupant intersects the floor.

BRoute.clearance: With center-XY/feet-Z coordinates, B and Zombie occupied boxes meet only at their initial x-boundary; boundary contact is not positive-volume overlap. The first northward segment moves away from that boundary, and the eastward segment at y=-10 remains clear of the Zombie at y=-20. Floor support is continuous.
